scope: Two optional color collections for data marks and scales on white. The original five-color sequence remains the default plotting cycle.

aps-cycle.name: Five-color cycle
aps-cycle.encoding: Five identity colors in the established plotting order.

RdBu_r.name: Blue, white and red
RdBu_r.encoding: The original reversed red-blue Matplotlib scale.

condition-pair.name: Paired tones
condition-pair.encoding: Two mark colors, two matching fills and a neutral link.

cohort-distributions.name: Three tones with tints
cohort-distributions.encoding: Three dark strokes and three lighter fills in matching order.

trace-pair.name: Teal and berry
trace-pair.encoding: Two dark strokes and their lighter tints.

focus-context.name: Accent and context
focus-context.encoding: A quiet field, a principal stroke, an accent and a reference ink.

magnitude-blue.name: Blue gradient
magnitude-blue.encoding: Five light-to-dark anchors with an independent missing-value color.

signed-balance.name: Blue, neutral and brick
signed-balance.encoding: Two ordered arms meeting at a light neutral center.

epoch-windows.name: Interval backgrounds
epoch-windows.encoding: Two mark colors and two pale background fills.

feature-order.name: Cream to plum
feature-order.encoding: A light-to-dark sequence with a separate summary accent and reference ink.

wrapped-phase.name: Closed color cycle
wrapped-phase.encoding: A continuous scale whose two ends meet.
